text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: You see, I felt totally freeee when running, and went whooooosh――

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All the other girls were piping hot too, just like a freshly baked lasagna~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
So, that's why!
It was so much fun~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I hope I can run like I did today in the next Mile CS too~♪

The 1,400m graded race went smoothly.
She should have no trouble handling the Mile CS.
choice_data_list: Just one more month, let's do our best!

It's a grand autumn stage where top-tier Umamusume gather!
